name: Massmore_ST7789
description: Driver for the Massmore ST7789 IPS TFT LCD module 1.3" / 1.54" / 2.0" with SD card and CST816 capacitive touch (SKU-1021). Based on TFT_eSPI (vendored) with ready-to-use Thai smooth fonts Kanit and Sarabun, automatic Thai tone-mark positioning, chip identity verification, CST816 touch driver and a Factory Test sketch.
